items.title: Jalen Coker: Salvages night with TD in loss
items.body_text: Coker secured two of five targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. He also lost a fumble. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Love: Stays hot in Week 9 win
items.body_text: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bryce Young: Struggles again in defeat
items.body_text: Young completed 23 of 41 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian Watson: Suffers broken rib Thursday
items.body_text: Watson said he suffered a broken rib in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tucker Kraft: Back in end zone during win
items.body_text: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
